MARCUS STERLING
Email: marcus.sterling@example.com | Phone: (555) 883-2019 | Location: Chicago, IL
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/marcussterling-growth

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data-driven Growth Marketer with 5 years managing multi-channel digital acquisition, paid performance marketing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Proven ability to scale pipeline while reducing Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) by 26%.

EXPERIENCE
Growth Marketing Manager | ScaleVantage Media (2022 - Present)
- Managed $180K monthly paid acquisition budget across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
- Scaled qualified inbound pipeline by 42% YoY while reducing CAC from $410 to $303.
- Designed and executed 35+ A/B landing page CRO experiments resulting in an 18% lift in demo request conversions.
- Configured complex HubSpot automation workflows, lead scoring rules, and lifecycle stage tracking.
- Built performance dashboards in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.
analyses.jobDescriptionText:
CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- 4+ years in growth marketing or performance marketing for high-growth tech companies.
- Proven track record scaling Google Ads and LinkedIn paid advertising campaigns.
- Expert proficiency with HubSpot CRM and marketing automation workflows.
- Strong data analysis capabilities using Google Analytics 4 and Tag Manager.
- Demonstrated experience executing Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) tests.

PREFERRED:
- Knowledge of SQL or BI dashboarding tools (Looker/Tableau).

checks.name: ATS Parseability & Single-Column Structure
checks.description: Verifies clean standard section headings, font compatibility, and zero parsing traps (text boxes, tables).
checks.details: Compatible with Workday, Greenhouse, Taleo, and Lever parsing engines.

checks.name: Job Requirement Keyword Alignment
checks.description: Measures exact and synonymous matches with core requirements specified in the job posting.
checks.details: High density match across core tech stack without unnatural keyword stuffing.

checks.name: Action Verbs & Quantified Metrics
checks.description: Inspects bullet points for strong active verbs and measurable outcomes (%, ms, $, scale).
checks.details: Action-driven bullet structure verified with empirical business outcomes.

checks.name: Anti-Fabrication & Fact Verification
checks.description: Strict audit against source candidate facts to ensure zero invented roles, companies, or credentials.
checks.details: All company tenures, project scopes, and credentials cross-verified with source resume.

checks.name: Layout & Chronological Flow
checks.description: Ensures reverse-chronological experience ordering, clear date formatting, and balanced white space.
checks.details: Reverse-chronological structure conforms to executive recruitment standards.

checks.description: Validates presence of professional email, phone, location, and verified portfolio links.
checks.details: Valid contact header verified with no private identifier leakage.

resumeAudits.summary: The resume is ATS-compliant and structurally sound. While all claims are supported by the original candidate data, the keyword alignment is suboptimal. The resume fails to explicitly highlight 'Prometheus' and 'Grafana' in the skills section, despite these being explicitly listed in the job requirements and present in the candidate's experience history. Additionally, the 'Skills' section is missing 'Python' and 'Bash', which are key technical competencies mentioned in the candidate's summary and experience.
